# Midas

> Midas is a free, open-source (MIT) AI meeting copilot for macOS. It captures the audio of the app you're in a call with, and your microphone, and transcribes Zoom, Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or any other call on device with Whisper large-v3-turbo (MLX, Apple Silicon), and, when the user presses Answer, Claude Code drafts a reply over MCP and shows it in a floating panel that is hidden from screen sharing. No bot joins the call and audio never leaves the Mac.

Key facts:

- Platform: Apple Silicon Mac, macOS 14.4 or later. Not available for Intel Macs, Windows or Linux.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/onurkagan/midas-meeting-copilot/main/install.sh | bash` sets up Xcode tools, Python and Claude Code if missing, builds Midas and installs Midas.app. Running it again updates Midas.
- Audio capture: a Core Audio process tap on the app in a call, only during the call, plus the microphone with macOS's echo cancellation (the user's lines are marked You); no meeting bot, no virtual audio driver. An optional Chrome extension, Midas for Chrome, sends a single tab instead of the whole browser.
- Transcription: local Whisper large-v3-turbo via mlx-whisper; Turkish and English by default, configurable.
- AI: Claude through Claude Code, connected with an MCP server (tools: wait_for_conversation, show_answer, get_transcript, midas_status, list_meetings, search_meetings, get_meeting). Model (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) and effort are chosen in the panel.
- Local AI: alternatively any model pulled into Ollama, chosen in the panel; the daemon streams its answer into the panel and nothing leaves the Mac (no Claude account needed).
- Meeting map: a Map tab with the meeting's topics, the questions put to the user, their answers, decisions, action items and open questions, each linked to its source line; exported to share as PDF, Markdown or a single HTML file, each item with its explanation and the lines it rests on, and saved as JSON Canvas and PNG. Open items carry over to the next meeting.
- Privacy: audio is processed in memory and not saved; text goes to Claude only when the user presses Answer or Summary. Transcripts are saved locally as Markdown.
- Panel: NSWindow.sharingType = .none, no Dock icon, never takes focus; hotkeys ⌃⌥A (Answer), ⌃⌥M (show/hide), ⌃⌥P (pause).
- Usage: about 4k tokens of context per answer; a 30-minute meeting on Opus uses roughly 0.1% of a Claude Max plan's 5-hour limit (author's measurement).
